fixes: cut the mantle with a seam and a draped fold over each shoulder instead of puffed ellipsoids

proportions.reason: Shoulders are narrower than before and the beard blends into the cheek; the mantle masses are still bulbous for the head and the face reads young and doll-like for the beard.
fixes: flatten the shoulder masses ~10 % on top
deepen the eye sockets and cheek planes so the face ages with the beard

materials.reason: Skin, hair, red wool, blue tunic, linen and brass collar separate by hue, and the brighter strand shading reads as hair in hero.png; mantle and tunic share one matte roughness, the cheeks carry a pink smudge under the eyes, and a grey-violet wash under the beard on the neck reads as a bruise in hero.png.

fade the beard edge into skin tone, not a grey-violet wash on the neck
skin roughness variation (oily T-zone, matte cheeks)
